The '''F5-SC Fighter''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The F5-SC Fighter appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. It was a reward to players who invited five friends using the Refer a Friend system.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
